checks.evidence: docs/design-system.md records voice, palette, density, imagery, refusals and the component state matrix before the component edits.

Catalog, product, cart, account and order states have skeleton, empty, pending, success and request-ID error treatments where applicable. A public per-size stock state is unavailable in the existing product DTO; the UI explains that stock is checked at reservation. Skeleton geometry and every slow state have not had a full manual screen-reader pass.

Eight locally committed v2 JPG/WebP references; per-asset Pexels source, author, commercial licence URL, 2026-09-29 retrieval and release status are in docs/design-system.md. No identifiable faces. The set is temporary and varies in lighting/cut/colour; garment accuracy is not claimed.

Isolated production preview manually completed signup, add to cart, quantity 1 to 2 with server total $158.00, and removal. Failed PUT returned a human message and support request ID with pending state cleared. Checkout provider flow and paid order remain unobserved because test credentials are absent. API money, owner scope, payment and caching code were not edited.

Production preview in Google Chrome via @playwright/test chromium inspected /, /products/canvas-overshirt, /cart, /account and /orders/not-an-order at 320, 375, 390, 414, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 CSS px. documentElement.scrollWidth equalled clientWidth in all 45 observations; no pageerror occurred. Long names/emails were not exhaustively inspected.

Manual keyboard pass at 390px reached Skip to content then navigation; focused size control had a visible 3px outline. Reduced-motion emulation yielded 0s transition duration. Semantic labels, live regions and aria-current were reviewed in code. A screen-reader pass and full rendered contrast audit were not completed.

Production Next build on local loopback, Google Chrome headless via @playwright/test, 390x844 mobile emulation with 4x CPU throttle, 150ms latency, 200000 B/s down and 75000 B/s up: 3 LCP runs 720/628/616ms (median 628ms), CLS 0.01105/0.00048/0.00048 (median 0.00048). Desktop 1440x900 unthrottled: LCP 180/320/168ms (median 180ms), CLS 0 in all 3. Navigation used networkidle plus 1s observation. This is a local warm-server lab observation, not field CWV. INP and Lighthouse category scores were not measured; 99+ target is unverified.

commands: pnpm lint (passed after fixing unused preloadLarge)
@playwright/test Chromium production preview manual viewport and interaction scripts (Node heredocs; no automated test suite)
docker push (both immutable ECR image tags)
AWS SSM release.sh dry-run and deploy on existing staging host

deployment.evidence: Release created a PostgreSQL backup, applied migrations and seed, reported healthy API/web/edge/PostgreSQL and passed HTTPS smoke. Independent HTTPS 200 home/photo, eight v2 catalog paths, 401 anonymous cart and HTTP 308 checks passed. Public Chrome at 390px showed eight cards, loaded product image, no overflow or page errors. Initial attempt failed before migration because the host needed ECR login; existing instance role login and retry succeeded.
